dsDescriptionValue.value: MobiPhysio is a 2D video-based dataset designed to support research and development in AI-based physiotherapy assessment systems. It contains rehabilitation exercise videos from different camera angles and a wide range of movement variations. These variations make MobiPhysio suitable for training and evaluating robust AI models capable of handling real-life scenarios. Each video is labeled and categorized by exercise type, with expert guidance from certified physiotherapists to ensure clinical relevance. MobiPhysio aims to promote accessible, 2D camera-based physiotherapy solutions that can operate without expensive sensor-based systems.
